bio_en: Grigor Amirian was born in 1888 in Nor Bayazit and became one of the chief comrades-in-arms of Sebouh and Murad. In the First World War he fought on the front lines in the battles of Rowanduz, where he was a witness to the heroic death of Keri in 1916. He spent his last years in California, where he died on 8 August of an unstated year; earth from Armenia sent by his nephew George Mardikian was scattered on his grave.
